title: Upstream crosslink observation: TIMEOUT sentinel never written — timeout kill leaves agents classified RUNNING

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: SOURCE (attended-design knowledge page, 2026-07-20): the harvest checks for a TIMEOUT sentinel that nothing ever writes — the timeout kill leaves the agent classified RUNNING, caught only by the wall-clock check against .kickoff-metadata.json. Impact: vsdd's never-started/stalled/timeout classification consumes these sentinels (dispatch-manifest round-parity queries); a phantom-RUNNING state after timeout kill corrupts the started-then-stalled vs timed-out distinction. Ask: write the sentinel at kill time.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Rolled into the kickoff epic: https://github.com/magnificentlycursed/crosslink/issues/2 (tracks the full vsdd kickoff bundle with upstream dollspace-gay/crosslink links; check-off happens there as upstream fixes land).

comments.content: CLOSED (tracked upstream): filed as dollspace-gay/crosslink#60, fix in flight (their PR #65); epic tracks.
